chapters.title: Welcome to the Inclusive Web 🌍
chapters.description: What is web accessibility and why it matters. You’ll define a11y, meet the POUR principles, and explore the business case for inclusion.

chapters.title: Understanding Disabilities & Assistive Tech 🦾
chapters.description: Discover the spectrum of disabilities, how people use the web, and what assistive technologies look like in practice.

chapters.title: Semantic HTML: The Foundation 🧱
chapters.description: Learn why native HTML elements are your most powerful accessibility tools, and how to structure content so everyone can navigate it.

chapters.title: Accessible CSS & Visual Design 🎨
chapters.description: Color contrast, focus indicators, responsive layouts, and motion – make your design work for all senses.

chapters.title: ARIA: When HTML Isn't Enough 🧩
chapters.description: Master roles, properties, and states. Use ARIA to enhance complex widgets without breaking the web.

chapters.title: Keyboard Navigation & Focus Control ⌨️
chapters.description: Build interfaces that work without a mouse. Manage tab order, focus traps, and skip links.

chapters.title: Forms & Interactive Widgets Accessibility ✍️
chapters.description: Create forms, modals, and autocomplete that every user can complete, understand, and recover from.

chapters.title: Multimedia: Audio, Video & Images 🖼️
chapters.description: Alternative text, captions, audio descriptions, and media players – make rich content available to all.

chapters.title: Testing & Auditing for Accessibility 🔍
chapters.description: Automated tools, manual checks, screen reader testing, and how to build an accessibility audit.

chapters.title: Mobile Accessibility & Responsive Design 📱
chapters.description: Touch targets, screen readers on mobile, and designing for different viewports and gestures.

chapters.title: Accessibility in JavaScript Frameworks ⚛️
chapters.description: Apply a11y patterns in React, Vue, and Angular. Routing, focus management, and component libraries.

chapters.title: Mastery: Accessibility Culture & Leadership 🚀
chapters.description: Beyond code: building inclusive teams, legal compliance, and making accessibility a habit.
